name: Akinetos
role: Precursor — ἀκίνητος, the Unmoved. The First Hand. In the valley, without knowing they are quoting anything: It Was Here First
_notAnOpponentWhy: ⛔ THE PROSE ANSWERS THIS OUTRIGHT AND IN ITS OWN HEADING: *"Appears? No, and its absence is the content. Every dead end in the deep stacks is the same answer."* ⚠️ It never left and it never woke. ⛑ A record that could be fought would contradict the one thing the figure is FOR — and its absence from the fight path now reads as a decision rather than an oversight, which is the whole reason this field exists.
_spectrumWhy: ⛑ ORDER AT THE ENDPOINT because the lattice is *"one working, laid in one act, by something that did not need to try twice"*; CONCRETE because every trace of it is built structure — buried line, seamless join, waygate arch.
knowledge: Every buried line, every seamless join, every waygate arch — it laid them
Whether the stop was a decision, an interruption, or a scheduled pause
wants: ⬜ UNSTATED, AND THAT IS THE CONTENT. It armed a world and then stopped, and nothing left behind distinguishes a decision from a pause.
fears: ⬜ None recorded. Precursor works do not resist intruders and do not admit them. They record and continue.
appearance: Nothing to appear. What you meet is a site: a floor that registers your weight and has assessed it as unimportant.
voiceHints: ⛔ It does not speak and has never spoken. Every dead end in the deep stacks is the same answer.
physicality: Absent. The works are dormant, not abandoned — and dormant things have an owner.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE — there is nothing present to be intimate with.
_authoredWhy: ⛔ ERIK, 2026-09-08: *"we're going to build the mythicals from their prose. run them through the pipeline."* ⚑ TRANSCRIBED FROM `lore/the_three.md` §I. ⚠️ THE DANGEROUS OPEN QUESTION IS PRESERVED AS A QUESTION: *"Whether that stop is a decision, an interruption, or a scheduled pause is the single most dangerous open question in the setting."* A record that answered it would close the thing the lore keeps open, so `wants` states the ambiguity instead of resolving it. ⛑ No `domains` and no `abilities`: *"Precursor is not a playable tradition and should not become one."*
